name: Union Pearson Express replacement; formerly Brampton / Highway 27
description: The old regular 35 ran Brampton–Humber College–North York until 2015. Contemporary 35B/35C feed entries are UP Express replacement services, a separate reuse.

timeline.event: The Brampton table identifies 35 via Humber College toward North York.
The regular Brampton/Highway 27 route 35 was discontinued.

sources.title: GO Brampton Local / Highway 27 and Highway 427 Express table 34, effective 1 September 2012, routes 34 / 35 / 36
Metrolinx GO Transit Ridership Report, September 2016 (original report, archived by Steve Munro)

gaps: The old 35 introduction date is unknown.
Modern 35B/35C patterns belong to dated GTFS; their presence does not establish a permanent conventional daily route.
The first date of number 35’s modern reuse remains unverified.

GTFS dates identify captured feeds, not necessarily the first or last day of a route. Open a pattern to see its exact scheduled service dates. Temporary rail replacement and special-service patterns are included when present in the source.
Manually reconstructed versions generally contain published timetable timing points / major stops. They must not be read as complete roadside stop inventories.
